text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Trainer <username>, Thank you for your hard 
work. Here is my report from my time off."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Meal details attached in the document. On 
sunny days, light jogs to break a light 
sweat; otherwise focused on rest through 
reading and studying." —

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look over the vacation report sent by 
Air Messiah. Just as I finish reading it, 
the door opens.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I will return to training starting today. 
I look forward to your continued guidance 
and support.

text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah's complexion looks great. Just 
as the report said, it seems she enjoyed a 
relaxing break and rested both mind and 
body thoroughly.
